readback: When a member has made transactions at 3 different stores (distinct H_Location values), they get a one-time bonus of 300 DELTA MILES points.
assumptions: A 'store' means a distinct value of H_Location. Every location counts, including the online store (WEB).
Any activity type counts as a visit. No activity type filter was given.
No start or end date was given, so the offer runs with no time limit until dates are set.
'Once' means the bonus is paid one time per member over the life of the offer.
